task: Reconstruct decisions one month at a time from the supplied guidance and assumed transaction labels, without full-period return backtests.
initial_boundary: 2016-08-17 is not month-end. Record it as the supplied initial allocation, not as an independently established regular monthly decision. Begin rule reconstruction with 2016-08-31.
decision_information: Only trailing features and contemporaneous candidate membership. No subsequent returns, NAV, CAGR, Sharpe or image-fit loss is used in this study.
process: Freeze the candidate universe and factor snapshot at each decision date.
Record the target three, entries, exits and retained names.
Compare every chosen name with every eligible unchosen name.
Test whether a guidance-compatible score can select exactly these three this month.
Carry the previous compatible rule into the next month before using its labels.
Intersect ranking constraints with earlier months. If inconsistent, retain the conflict rather than silently changing weights each month.
Write individual decision cards, including counterexamples and unresolved alternatives.
features: Reuse the 6 positive momentum core features (6/9/12-month raw and risk-adjusted returns, all skipping 42 sessions) and 10 volatility/industry/price-volume side factors already documented. No security/date dummy variables or new unrelated factors.
normalization_hypotheses: percentile ranks within the whole contemporaneous proxy universe
raw magnitude scaled by that date's 10th/90th percentiles and clipped to [0,1]
percentile ranks separately within stocks and ETFs before comparing their scores
guidance_interpretation: Momentum weights nonnegative and consume at least 50% of an L1-normalized score budget; side factors may have either sign. This numerical dominance constraint and normalization are hypotheses, not author-disclosed facts.
solver: Maximum common chosen-minus-unchosen score margin by linear programming; preserve solver status, primal/dual objective and worst inequality. Positive strict margin confirms only within-family feasibility for that month.
small_model_diagnostic: A hypothetical arbitrary +/-0.05 per-security correction is reported only as an oracle feasibility envelope, never called a fitted model or used as a reproduced decision.
prohibitions: Do not concatenate per-month fitted rules into a backtest, change labels, use later-month labels to explain an earlier decision, relax the original curve gate, or change live observation accounts.
